Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.pgsql

Class PostgresConnector

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.pgsql.PostgresConnector
All Implemented Interfaces:
Connector
public final class PostgresConnector extends Object implements Connector
The Connector for PostgreSQL, driver name pgsql.

A connection is described either by a url, used as given, or by host, port (default 5432) and database. The sslmode option and the search_path option (also spelled schema) are added to the URL as the sslmode and currentSchema parameters of the PostgreSQL JDBC driver, unless the URL already sets them. The user name and password are never put in the URL; they go to the driver separately. The PostgreSQL JDBC driver must be on the application's class path.

The lock_wait option, a duration such as 5s or 500ms, sets the lock_timeout of every session through the options parameter of the URL; a value the URL already has in options is kept and the setting is added after it.

The optional timezone option, an IANA name such as UTC or an offset such as +03:00, runs SET TIME ZONE on every connection handed out (one statement per checkout), as Laravel does after connecting, whether the data source is built from the settings or supplied. It is off by default. Only letters, digits and / _ + - : are accepted. A pool that resets sessions (DISCARD ALL or RESET ALL) undoes it, so with such a pool set the zone in the pool's init SQL or on the server instead.

The migration lock is a PostgresMigrationLock over the connection's data source.

Instances hold no state and are safe to share across threads.

    • connect

      public Connection connect(ConnectionConfig config, DataSource dataSource)
      Builds a connection for a config.

      When the connector needs a resource that outlives the call, such as the anchor connection that keeps an in-memory database alive, it keeps the resource and releases it in Connector.close(Connection).

      Specified by:
      connect in interface Connector
      Parameters:
      config - the connection config, never null
      dataSource - the data source the user registered for this connection, or null when the connector must build its own from the config
      Returns:
      the connection, never null
      Throws:
      DatabaseConfigException - if neither url nor host and database are set, or the timezone option holds a disallowed character
